comment: None of the twelve inputs or the three outputs is named in configInput or configOutput, so Rack's tooltips are blank on all of them. Input 4 (ROTATE_INPUT) and parameter 10 (ROTATE_PARAM) are declared in the enums and given no widget, and ROTATE_PARAM has no configParam either, so neither can be reached or clicked; the jacks around them are not renumbered. The panel prints LEFT and TOP where configParam names the parameters X and Y. EOS tests Positions[c] == 0 (src/CellularAuto.cpp:354), but every channel above the first restarts at c * cells rather than 0, so EOS fires only on channel 0 however many channels the clock carries. RULE is clamped below at 0 and not above, and the rule byte is applied with a bitwise and against 1 << index, so anything above 255 acts as its remainder. Each ITER pass runs a full 256 rows carrying on from the last, so the grid kept is the last 256 generations. The four button inputs are summed with their buttons before a SchmittTrigger, so a steady voltage above 1V holds the trigger high and blocks further presses of the button beside it.
